Anna (Product): quick heads-up — getting a support ticket: saved filters (in Console) appearing across unrelated routes. Customer expected route-scoped behavior.
Sahil (Console): is this the save-*filters* flow or saved query boards? any repro steps?
Anna (Product): save-filters from the inspector. If you save without specifying model, the view ends up visible on other routes that share that model field — they expected the default to be 'route-scoped'.
Marco (Eng-Console): thats intentional historically — saves were global to make shareability simpler. But I agree it's surprising.
Jess (Platform): key risk: we show per-route quota previews tied to routes. If saved filters are global, customers see quota estimates that don't match where the view is applied.
Sahil (Console): simple UX fix: add a 'Scope' dropdown in save modal: [Route (default), Model, Global]. Default could be route for new saves.
Anna (Product): +1. For existing saves we need a migration strategy — maybe mark legacy saves as 'global' unless we can infer a single dominant route.
Marco (Eng-Console): backend implications: schema needs a `scope` enum and optional `route_id`/`model_id`. API shape example:
`POST /api/saved_filters` payload:
`{ "name": "Errors last 24h", "filter": {...}, "scope": "route", "route_id": "rt_abc123" }`
Sahil (Console): we should also render an 'applies-to' badge in the list: `applies to: route=...` or `global` so people don't guess.
telemetry-bot: telemetry: saved_filter.create triggered 1.2k/day; top routes: rt_abc123, rt_xyz789
Jess (Platform): rollout plan: add feature-flagged UI + schema change. Canary on ~10% orgs, capture telemetry delta for saved_filter.apply and quota-preview-mismatch events.
Marco (Eng-Console): I'll draft the schema PR. Need to coordinate migration window and index re-write for search (we index filters by route/model now).
Sahil (Console): I can mock the UI with the 'Scope' dropdown and 'applies-to' pill. Want to include a small inline help copy: "Route: visible only when on this route".
Anna (Product): A/B idea: default-to-route for new saves; for legacy saves, surface a 'Make route-scoped' quick action in the details modal.
Jess (Platform): also add a guard: when someone tries to save a global filter in a high-traffic org, show a quota preview warning (estimated cross-route token burn).
Sahil (Console): implementation tasks:
- Marco: schema + API PR
- Sahil: UI mock + front-end changes
- Jess: telemetry + quota-preview adjustments
- Anna: write short release note and support FAQ
Anna (Product): ok assigning in Jira after this thread. Will follow up with acceptance criteria and a quick mock. :thumbsup:
Marco (Eng-Console): ack, starting on PR tomorrow.
Sahil (Console): ack, will drop mocks by EOD Wed.
telemetry-bot: note: created event saved_filter.migration_suggestion queued for 4 orgs for pilot
Jess (Platform): thanks team — sync up later this week for handoff.
